entries.title: Deathloop
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows version with Goldenloop update

primary.version: Current PC version with Goldenloop update
primary.why: Deathloop released on PlayStation 5 and Windows in 2021, then Xbox Series X/S in 2022 alongside the Goldenloop update. Windows is the highest-fidelity archive route because it has the best capture/settings ceiling, and cross-platform PvP matchmaking works after the Goldenloop update.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through Steam, Epic, or Microsoft Store. Verify Goldenloop update content and current PvP/service behavior before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Goldenloop update state matters; verify current crossplay/PvP service behavior before capture.
